      • printAssertions

        @NotNull
public @NotNull AssertionCodeGenerator printAssertions()
        Generates code for assertions according to all public properties of the passed in object. This saves some of the tedious effort do generate assertions checking the state of an object. You can employ this in your unitest temporarily instead of the assertions, manually check whether it is as expected, and copy the printed code into the test once it was run.
